items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 4:24am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Gales/ severe gales at first.


##Wind)##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, decreasing 7 or gale 8 this afternoon, 6 or 7 this evening, then backing SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate or rough later today, then slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Showers soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C

##Warnings)##

Gales developing later.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, soon backing SE 5 to 7, veering S or S-SW 7 or gale 8 later in day, veering SW overnight.

Slight or moderate at first, soon building moderate or rough, then rough or very rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then rain for a time.

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.

14°C
